name: Topological Sorting and DAG Levels
shortfall_explanation: cuGraph has CUDA topological levels, but no paired research PDF was verified. DGL topological traversal falls back to CPU, and TopoGPU solves a restricted image-derived DAG.
limitation_notes: A matching input variant can qualify without supporting every optional mode. Missing canonical adapters and absent runtime validation remain separate from research collection eligibility.

algorithms.algorithm_name: NVIDIA parallel DAG DFS and reverse postorder
algorithms.notes: Author CUDA artifact was not located. The public morpheusthewhite/parallel-dfs-dag repository is a C++/OpenMP reimplementation and is not counted as GPU code.
The C++ API returns a level per vertex. A valid ordered vertex list must be constructed from those levels. No associated research paper was verified.
Specialized to Morse/cubical-complex DAGs derived from image data; not a general edge-list DAG sorter. Retained as related GPU code, excluded from the general-problem target.
